verdict.rationale: The evidence documents subscription creation by assigning a plan, plan upgrades and downgrades, and an OpenAPI 3.1 schema that covers every endpoint, so a programmatic lifecycle API is plausible. No cited item ties subscription operations to specific API endpoints, and the only concrete assignment instructions are dashboard steps. missing for 10: explicit create/update subscription API endpoint docs, any evidence of pause, any evidence of cancel/terminate via API, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create, update, pause, and cancel subscriptions through a documented API — the full lifecycle without touching a dashboard

citations.quote: A subscription is created when a plan is assigned to a customer. You can assign a plan to a customer at any time
Customers have the flexibility to easily upgrade or downgrade their plan at any given moment.
Use Lago's OpenAPI 3.1 schema to generate clients, inspect typed operations, or expose billing actions to an AI agent.
Every endpoint in this reference has a generated command.
